clips.title: The story
paras: Elemental War is a task undertaken for Tsunaman, an envoy of the water elementals residing at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. Guided by the will of Neptulon the Tidehunter, adventurers are sent into the scorched depths of the Charred Vale to extinguish blazing fire elementals and collect their smoldering Incendrite cores. It provides a rare glimpse into the ancient, perpetual rivalry that divides the elemental planes.

In the rugged reaches of Stonetalon Mountains, an envoy named Tsunaman has arrived at Sun Rock Retreat on behalf of the Tribunal of the Tides. Acting under the supreme will of Neptulon the Tidehunter, the lord of water elementals, Tsunaman seeks to carry out an ancient vendetta against their fiery kin. Rather than a dispute over mortal borders, this conflict represents the unending clash of Azeroth's primal forces.

The primary battleground for this struggle is the Charred Vale, a scarred wasteland smoldering in southern Stonetalon Mountains. Fire elementals thrive amidst the ashes, threatening the surrounding regions. Adventurers are enlisted to descend into the vale, snuff out these flame-wreathed entities, and gather Incendrites—blazing remnants left behind upon an elemental's defeat—to prove their destruction to the Tribunal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.
Friend, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
